display.title: Lane: Engineering
display.subtitle: Build your way up
description: The Engineering lane converts refined materials and finished machines
into progression tokens, submitted at the Codex.
Bulk metals convert at a modest rate and are §ecapped§r per material -
the real weight comes from high-value machine blocks (Create at T1,
Thermal at T2, Mekanism at T3).
Follow the Engineering chapter to learn the conversion tables.
§7See the Engineering group in this quest book.
